method: REA drives a loopback controller. An independent laboratory bootstrap loads the unchanged original core in a fresh synthetic vault and profile. Self-authored fixture plugins are loaded by the original plugin manager and receive the original public API. The renderer invokes original APIs, observes DOM and files, and returns a report whose SHA-256 appears in REA DOM/accessibility capture. This is not a direct REA capture of the Electron surface and not an equality comparison with the independent implementation.
isolation: Fresh synthetic profile/session/vault per run; original core SHA-256 is pinned and rechecked. No real vault/account/credentials loaded. Guards deny remote Electron HTTP(S)/WS(S) and Node http/https.request/get, external URL opening and OS protocol registration. Only local synthetic HTTP request fixtures are allowed. The guard is not an operating-system sandbox. Original app and REA owned processes exit normally for every adopted run.
interpretation: complete/observed means that the probe completed and produced data. It does not mean that every attempted behavior was successful, that errors are desirable compatibility targets, or that the independent implementation passed. Findings apply only to the sampled core version, settings and inputs.
screenshotMethod: Original Electron windows are briefly shown without activation before capturePage, then hidden; PNG hashes are checked when copied into this reference bundle.

evidenceBoundary: REA operated the loopback controller and captured its report/hash; original Electron screenshots were independently captured through the laboratory shell.
The adapter base path was checked against the newly generated synthetic vault before any mutation.
Original methods and original DOM state were observed. No original implementation code was copied or changed.
Screenshots use showInactive, then return the laboratory window to hidden state; no foreground focus was requested.
All restoration here occurred within one original application process. No process restart, crash, DPI or multi-monitor restoration was measured.
Earlier runs layout01 and layout02 also completed with both exit codes zero and unchanged core hash; layout03 contains the expanded visible-line calibration and sidebar DOM checks.

layoutTree.topology: main split(vertical) -> tabs(A pinned,B selected), split(horizontal) -> tabs(C preview), tabs(D source)
layoutTree.observedSerialization: setDimension(number) produced the same number as that child's dimension field; measured DOM widths and row heights changed accordingly.
layoutTree.selectedTab: tabs.currentTab=1 selected the second child; right sidebar currentTab=2 selected its third child.
layoutTree.pin: Pinned leaf contains pinned:true at the leaf level and also in its state object returned by getViewState; unpinned samples omit this serialized key.

modes.sourceTrue: source mode with Markdown syntax visible

persistentMarkdownState.cursorAndScroll: Not present in sampled getLayout/getViewState/view.getState results; separately available through getEphemeralState.

changeLayoutRoundtrip.actions: Save original getLayout, detach other Markdown leaves, unpin/open Convert in the retained leaf, then changeLayout(saved).
changeLayoutRoundtrip.conclusion: This persistent layout restored hierarchy, leaf identities, active file, pin and mode samples, but did not restore the recreated active editor's cursor/scroll.
changeLayoutRoundtrip.inactiveLeafLimit: Immediately after restoration the hidden pinned Layout-A leaf retained its serialized file/mode/source/pin but exposed no view.file/editor/getMode; activating it in the later source-mode case produced the actual editor. Do not assume an inactive restored leaf is already loaded.

ephemeralSelectionAndScroll.conclusion: The tested source=true roundtrip restored the actual selection and visible line/offset. Numeric DOM scrollTop changed despite the same visible position, so this field must not be interpreted as a stored pixel offset.
ephemeralSelectionAndScroll.livePreviewLimit: Cursor restored and getEphemeralState echoed the supplied scroll; actual first visible text shifted from Line 092 to Line 093 in this run. Do not claim exact Live Preview scrolling.

scrollCalibration.fixtureLineMapping: Markdown line 0 is the heading, line 1 blank, line 2 contains Line 000 synthetic text.
scrollCalibration.limitedInterpretation: The 10.5 sample is consistent with source-line index plus fraction of a line, and the saved 63.189236 value matches that relation. The 80.25 sample did not land at an exact corresponding line fraction. General rounding, virtual measurements and long-document accuracy remain unestablished; do not use these samples to promise arbitrary exact scrolling.

sidebars.serialization: Expanded sidebar samples omit collapsed; collapsed samples contain collapsed:true. Width is retained while collapsed and reused by expand().
sidebars.actualChecks: Selected headers carry is-active; search/outline leaf visibility and DOM widths were read after collapse/expand, not inferred only from JSON.

events.dimensionCase: Only resize was observed during the direct setDimension calls plus explicit workspace.onResize.
events.ephemeralCases: No subscribed workspace events were observed during the active-leaf saved ephemeral roundtrip or scroll-unit calibration. The source-selection case first activated a different, deferred leaf and did emit resize/active-leaf-change/file-open/layout-change; that sequence does not isolate selection setters as the cause.
events.limit: Counts and ordering belong to this bounded sequence and may include deferred/coalesced events; no universal one-event-per-operation guarantee is established.

excludedExploration.reason: Plugin source did not run because the fresh profile started in restricted mode; superseded by explicit synthetic-profile enable in discover02.
Successful initial editor sample; editor02 adds main-selection parameter and valid Editor.exec command samples.
Response HTTP status overwrote one top-level observation status field; renamed field and repeated as data02.
A function-valued report field caused IPC serialization failure; owned original app exited normally after stop; no final report.
Initial rendering observation; native snapshot was taken before fresh-paint callbacks completed.
Superseded by full post-disable child cleanup and inactive-view observations.
Superseded by explicit ItemView setState ordering in render05.
Initial layout observation; lacked visible-line calibration for ephemeral scrolling.
Superseded by additional fixed-scroll and sidebar DOM calibration in layout03.

limitations: Programmatic original API and DOM operations do not establish physical keyboard/mouse usability.

The synthetic composition run uses untrusted CompositionEvent plus document.execCommand. It does not reproduce the Windows IME candidate/pre-edit/input sequence and cannot establish native IME correctness or native data-loss behavior.
The separately available API declaration file is version 1.14.4; it guided probe design but is not evidence that core 1.13.7 implements every current type contract.
Layout restoration occurred within one original process; process restart, crash, DPI, multi-monitor geometry and arbitrary layout precision remain untested.

Ephemeral scroll is not a pixel offset. The source-mode visible-line roundtrip succeeded for one case, but Live Preview and distant fixed-scroll samples differed; arbitrary exact scrolling is not established.
HTTP fixtures cover loopback success, binary POST, redirect, error and decoding only; no original cloud, public internet, production security or authentication flow was exercised.
No arbitrary community plugin, all public APIs, CodeMirror extension ecosystem or private API compatibility is established.
Original source files were neither patched nor copied into this bundle; only self-authored probes, fixture inputs and observations are included.
